body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 Lightning Damage and suppress 1 point of its ordinary magical Movement bonuses until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, push it 1 unit.
After a hit, end the selected Movement bonus if it is ordinary and magical.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Elemental
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Elemental Full Manifestation (FM-2E). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
